column1: # techneissa's fork: interface text for fork features, added to craft-i18n's locales/pt-br/photocraft.tsv at build time (crates/ui-egui/fork_i18n.rs). Rows the official catalog already has are dropped.

column2: Models are optional and run entirely on this computer. Downloading fetches the model file from Hugging Face; no images or documents are ever uploaded. Without a model, Select Subject, Remove Background and Remove Subject use the built-in (non-AI) methods.
column3: Os modelos são opcionais e executados inteiramente neste computador. O download obtém o arquivo do modelo do Hugging Face; imagens e documentos nunca são enviados. Sem um modelo, Selecionar objeto, Remover fundo e Remover objeto usam os métodos integrados sem IA.
